decisions.decision: Menu primitive: build a new Menu wrapping Base UI's Menu, not reuse Dropdown
decisions.rationale: Dropdown wraps Base UI Select (value-picker semantics, wrong ARIA role for an action menu); Base UI 1.7.0 does ship a full Menu entry point despite the plan's research doc claiming otherwise

decisions.decision: Board list ordering: reverse the fetched GET /boards array client-side for newest-first
decisions.rationale: Backend returns creation-order (oldest first); id-string-sort-descending and array-reversal produce identical output on observed data, user picked the simpler array-reversal

decisions.decision: Access control: proceed with board plans as written, no escalation needed
decisions.rationale: 02-06's probe found all 3 cross-account access attempts (including one using the victim's own userId) rejected with 403 — backend derives identity from session cookie server-side, does not trust client-supplied userId

decisions.decision: Toast: rounded-sm radius (4px, matches Text Field/Dropdown token) instead of rounded-lg (Modal's radius)
decisions.rationale: User explicitly requested matching Text Field's radius over the Modal-radius convention toast.tsx originally copied

decisions.decision: Toast long-content: clamp Title(2 lines)/Description(3 lines) with overflow hidden, full text via native title attribute (hover tooltip), not a CSS hover-expand
decisions.rationale: A CSS hover-expand risked overlapping the toast stacked below it in the Stacked story

decisions.decision: Sidebar board links: real next/link Link, not a plain <a>
decisions.rationale: A plain <a> (copied from an auth-form precedent where full-page-reload doesn't matter) caused every board-to-board click to be a full page reload instead of client-side navigation — the app's most frequent interaction. next/link's ReferenceError: process is not defined in Vitest Browser Mode is worked around by mocking next/link in the test file instead of avoiding it in the component.

context_notes: Phase 2 (Board Management) is 13 plans across 11 waves, mostly sequential single-plan waves with heavy UI content and checkpoints. Waves 1-5 (plans 02-01 through 02-07) are fully merged, tested, and pushed to origin/master, including a merged+CI-green visual-baselines PR for the new Toast/Menu primitives. Wave 6 (02-08) is the first real board-data UI (sidebar + boards list) and went through an unusually long checkpoint loop: two false starts on session-budget-exhausted test accounts (backend caps 2 concurrent sessions per account; UI sign-out does NOT free a slot because the upstream sign-out endpoint is broken/500s — only the frontend cookie clears), a genuine full-page-reload regression the user caught (screenshots/DOM snapshots can't distinguish a full reload from client-side nav — only network-request inspection can), and a follow-up lint-hardening pass to close that gap systematically. The dev server for 02-08's worktree is still running at http://localhost:3000 (worktree-agent-aff6e55fca144924a's own instance) — may or may not still be alive next session, check before reusing. This session established a working pattern: before handing any UI checkpoint back to the user, independently inspect it with browser tools first (Playwright MCP) rather than trusting the executor subagent's self-report — this is now saved as a standing memory preference (feedback_ui_change_signoff.md) along with a companion preference to investigate lint-rule coverage after any bug that slipped past tests/types/screenshots (feedback_lint_hardening_after_bugs.md).
